name: superpowers-audit
description: Writer-led independent audits of specifications, implementation plans, and brainstorming questions.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.description: Reviewer chains, one entry per member, as writer-provider/model=reviewer-provider/model[#variant]. Repeat a writer to add the next reviewer in order.

maxRounds.title: Maximum audit rounds
maxRounds.description: Positive integer limiting the audit rounds per reviewer on each target.

artifactDirectory.title: Artifact directory
artifactDirectory.description: Directory for audit artifacts, as a path relative to the project root.
